crossRefs.note: But if any harm follows, then you must take life for life,
Your eyes shall not pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
“You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’

translations.web: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. It shall be done to him as he has injured someone.
translations.bsb: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. Just as he injured the other person, the same must be inflicted on him.
translations.kjv: Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done
translations.asv: breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be rendered unto him.
